summary: No reachable vulnerabilities. parseHandRecord: forcedFold must be exactly true or absent; with it, the user's non-blind actions must number decisions+1 and the last must be a fold, and decisions are still matched entry-by-entry against made[i] (street/type/amount), so forcedFold cannot hide a mismatched decision or accept a non-fold last action. A tampered IndexedDB record can only affect the user's own local view (no cross-user boundary). forceFold rejects completed hands, seats not dealt in, folded and all-in seats, never mutates input, removes the seat from pot eligibility, and reuses the shared settle() path (foldOut/endRound) so no hole cards are revealed beyond the existing fold-out/showdown rules; toAct stays on a still-open seat. foldUserToLeave only targets config.userSeat. LeaveDialog renders fixed text only (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML or interpolated data). No new dependencies, randomness, network or logging.
